title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Training Note — Treatment Progress Read from the Case Payment Record
content:
**Cascade Ortho Rider cases with installments already paid.** When Cascade has paid installments on the case, the share of treatment still to come in the recognised remaining-treatment fee is read from the case's own payment record.

- **Monthly schedule, at least one installment issued and not reversed:** the share is the installments of the schedule not yet issued, divided by the installments scheduled.
- **Quarterly schedule, at least one installment issued and not reversed:** the share is the months after the banding month not yet covered by an issued quarter, divided by the months after the banding month. Each issued installment covers three months, and the months not yet covered are never below zero.
- **Any other case:** the share is not read from the payment record. This includes a case with no installment issued and not reversed, a case planned for a single month, and a case whose schedule has no installment.

## Terms used

- **Months after the banding month:** the planned treatment months, not counting the banding month itself.
- **Installments scheduled:** the months after the banding month, limited to the rider's installment months cap, divided by the length of one service period (one month on a monthly schedule, three months on a quarterly schedule), and rounded up to a whole installment.
- **Issued:** an installment counts as issued when it is an installment payment on the case that has not been reversed.

| Rider | Schedule | Installment months cap |
|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | quarterly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | quarterly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | monthly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | quarterly | 24 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | monthly | 30 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | monthly | 30 |

## Questions answered (hypothetical cases)

**A monthly-schedule case planned for 22 months has 7 installments issued and none reversed. What share is still to come?** There are 21 months after the banding month, under the cap, so 21 installments are scheduled. 14 are not yet issued, so the share is 14 divided by 21, which is two thirds.

**A quarterly-schedule case planned for 19 months has 4 installments issued and none reversed.** There are 18 months after the banding month. Four quarters cover 12 of them and 6 are not yet covered, so the share is 6 divided by 18, which is one third.

**The same quarterly case has 7 installments issued.** Seven quarters would cover 21 months, which is more than 18, so the months not yet covered are zero and the share is zero.

**One of the 7 monthly installments above was reversed.** Only 6 count as issued, so the share is 15 divided by 21.
